Subject premiums of an excess of loss treaty

Source: R/reinsurance_pricing_data.R
xl_premium.Rd

The subject premium of each year 2015 to 2024 of the portfolio of xl_large_losses, with the rate index that brings it to the rates of 2025 and the development factor of its layer losses.

Usage

xl_premium

Format

A data frame with 10 rows and 4 columns:

year

The year.

premium

The subject premium of the year.

rate_index

The factor bringing the year's premium to the rates of 2025.

development

The development factor of the year's layer losses, for the losses not reported yet and the development of those reported.

Source

Simulated.

See also

burning_cost.

Examples

xl_premium
#>    year  premium rate_index development
#> 1  2015 41200000       0.94        1.00
#> 2  2016 42500000       0.96        1.00
#> 3  2017 43100000       0.99        1.00
#> 4  2018 44800000       1.02        1.01
#> 5  2019 46000000       1.05        1.02
#> 6  2020 47900000       1.06        1.04
#> 7  2021 50600000       1.04        1.08
#> 8  2022 53200000       1.03        1.15
#> 9  2023 55800000       1.01        1.30
#> 10 2024 58400000       1.00        1.65
